chapter: Tenor players, tours and band boys
title: Club-date and society bands beyond jazz
summary: He wanted to play all kinds of music and worked with Lester Lanin, Jerry Jerome and other single-engagement bands.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Stardust. He made Stardust way back then and was a big hit, uh huh. And then, well, you know, I was one of those kinds of musicians that I wanted to play all types of music -- I just didn't want to be playing jazz alone, so I tried to play almost everything, you know? Like I was with Lester Lanin's society band, and I worked with Jerry Jerome, and Charlie Scardino.
Yeah, Scardino. His wife was a piano player.
Called me for a gig the other day.
And I worked with Ray Block, Jerry
Rosen, Wayne Foster, Arthur Pugh -- I mean all these were bands not playing any jazz at all; they were playing strictly ...
Yeah, they were what you called single engagement bands -- club date bands.
